title: evidence-synthesis: P0 research subskill 4/9 + control 22 (grounded findings, earned)
objective: Build the evidence-synthesis research subskill: a concise SKILL.md that reduces adjudicated claims, contradictions and non-coverage into decision-relevant findings organised by consensus/strength/dispute/gap, surfacing contradictions and declaring gaps, with no acquisition/decision/authority. Add control 22 (earned by failing-first): every finding references at least one claim. Register IMPLEMENTED; badf-research stays DESIGNED (4 of 9 P0).
business_value: Synthesis is where 50 sources become a decision-relevant conclusion or a bad decision; grounding every finding in adjudicated claims makes a synthesis conclusion a function of the evidence rather than free assertion, and keeps contradictions and gaps visible to the later challenge and reconciliation steps.
